boundaries: All ten cash allocations sum to one. Other services retain full costs with health unquantified; zero credit is not a finding they are ineffective. This partial-health whole-gift estimate is not an upper bound on cost-effectiveness.

Completed-service cost includes coordination, overhead and failed referrals. Selected clinical subset, service-to-person conversion, financial additionality and disjointness are separate assumptions; service count alone is never a health outcome.

Current uninsured/ineligible-Medi-Cal eligibility is not a never-care baseline. Later safety-net care, coverage changes, other donors, donated provider capacity and OA's existing navigation remain in the counterfactual.

CRC uses an explicitly judgmental mean-hazard survival approximation. Cohort mortality association and navigationRCT are not causal manufacturer-like coefficients; no .13 completion multiplier or legacy aggregate.05Q is reused.

One exclusive linked-person ledger CRC then eye then hernia. Repeats/second eyes and overlapping diagnoses retain costs but cannot earn duplicate whole-person health. No productivity, caregiver or other mortality gains are added.

Donated clinical resources, distinct nonclinical support, patient time and downstream cancer-care allowances are gross associated costs on all nominal services, including uncredited/replaced activity. They are not waived charges, net incremental resources, or exhaustive societal cost.

Both health comparisons start with the same people alive at care. Delay discounts only; horizons start at care, not gift. Harms are already gift-date PV and include repeat procedures within an episode; late-comparator harms are not subtracted.
Bay and SF are nested weak residence priors, not measured local return. US equals all-region direct health here; no international or indirect local spillovers are credited.
Historical selectedSF$600,000 donor/$1,012,000 expanded price remains a separate program comparison. It must not remain the ordinary-gift ranking input after this revision.

paths.name: Non-FIT GI investigation → benign treatable dyspepsia/dysphagia management
paths.basis: Diagnostic procedure alone earns no cure; treatment linkage is a prior, alternative primary-care therapy remains baseline.

paths.name: Painful cyst/lipoma excision
paths.basis: Current OA procedure explicitly listed; utility and symptom-limiting fraction are priors, not cosmetic benefit.

paths.name: Symptomatic haemorrhoid/fissure treatment
paths.basis: Historical minor anorectal mix only; assume persistent symptoms despite medical management.

paths.name: Uncomplicated symptomatic gallstone surgery
paths.basis: C-GALL control includes later surgery; nonsignificant small integrated QALY difference; conservative care may suffice.

paths.name: Breast lesion diagnostic assessment and linked benign symptom treatment
paths.basis: No unverified cancer survival gain. Prior only for changed symptom management, not all negative tests.

paths.name: Refractory abnormal uterine bleeding → definitive outpatient treatment
paths.basis: Ms trial supports surgery vs expanded medical care; no hysterectomy-vs-ablation transfer, fertility/recovery losses retained.

paths.name: Symptomatic pelvic prolapse/incontinence treatment
paths.basis: Case-mix and utility priors, not confirmed OA frequency; pessary/conservative alternatives retained.

paths.name: Gynaecologic diagnostic workup → nonmalignant symptom management
paths.basis: Diagnosis without management has zero benefit through linkage; no automatic cancer cure.

paths.name: Carpal tunnel decompression for symptomatic confirmed CTS
paths.basis: Primary economic trial .04 at12months is nonsignificant point utility, not integrated QALY. .03 here is an independent transfer prior.

paths.name: Painful foot deformity / tendon or trigger-finger intervention
paths.basis: Named mechanical function hypothesis; OA ortho/podiatry totals not diagnosis frequencies. Utilities are priors. Torkki hallux-valgus RCT11368700 supports the painful-bunion subset only; two-year catch-up12807332 rules out lifelong timing gain.

paths.name: Degenerative knee arthroscopy without acute mechanical indication
paths.basis: Null benefit central, not assume all orthopaedic surgery is useful; harm retained.

paths.name: Septal nasal obstruction surgery versus nasal medical therapy
paths.basis: NAIROS validates symptom mechanism, not SNOT22-to-QALY conversion or universal ENT benefit.

paths.name: Conductive ear disease treatment
paths.basis: Clinical indication and utility priors; no all-ENT survival credit.

paths.name: Bothersome BPH/outlet obstruction treatment
paths.basis: TURP vs watchful waiting trial supports symptom relief, not current OA frequency; modern medication baseline matters.

paths.name: Symptomatic urinary stone treatment
paths.basis: No prophylactic life-saving claim for asymptomatic stones; spontaneous passage and medical treatment in comparator.

paths.name: Symptomatic benign scrotal/hydrocele treatment
paths.basis: Indication and finite utility priors; no infertility or cancer mortality award.

paths.name: Symptomatic benign skin cyst/lesion treatment
paths.basis: Current OA cyst/lipoma service; disjoint allocation from general surgery required.

paths.name: Localized skin lesion diagnosis and treatment
paths.basis: Symptom/functional relief only; no melanoma mortality extrapolation.

paths.name: Symptomatic uncomplicated varicose vein treatment
paths.basis: REACTIV randomized conservative comparator; integrated two-year .054Q not annual gain.

paths.name: Symptomatic pterygium treatment
paths.basis: Current OA explicitly offered; first-eye cataract cohort excluded; finite symptom/vision utility prior.

paths.name: Specialty assessment without established diagnosis-changing intervention
paths.basis: Only2%wholegift allocation; centralzero benefit explicitly due absent disease/intervention evidence, not blanket residual zero for major specialties.

scope: Expected whole-organization health CONDITIONAL on explicit diagnostic case-mix priors. All2025 specialty categories covered in a service ledger; other assessment2% receives zero benefit plus burden. No generic residual QALY/$ or inverse allocation uplift.
note: v1 selected-path estimate and source artifacts remain unchanged. v2 is an asset-only correction; external resources already cover all nominal services and are NOT added again.
